description: This file defines the HttpClientFacade interface, which provides methods to create HTTP requests using Akka HTTP client and manage associated ActorSystem instances within the security utilities of the Eclipse Ditto gateway service.

classes.name: HttpClientFacade
classes.description: Interface providing a pre-configured Akka HTTP client for executing HTTP requests and managing actor system instances.

methods.name: createSingleHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates a CompletionStage for the passed HttpRequest containing the HttpResponse.

methods.name: getActorSystem
methods.description: Returns an ActorSystem instance which can be used for stream execution.
